mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, lowering discount rates and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 3.8% triggers concerns about labor market weakening, reducing investor confidence and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 3.8% in the next month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces non-negative 5-day forward returns despite UNRATE crossing above 3.8% in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in both GDP demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) indicate robust economic expansion, amplifying equity demand and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or HOUST does not rise concurrently, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained federal funds rates above 2.4% during a tightening cycle compresses discount rates, reducing present value of future cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS remains above 2.4% for the next month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns despite FEDFUNDS remaining above 2.4% for the next month.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in the industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects expanding supply capacity and boosts market optimism, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not trend upward or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of GDP demand (GDPC1) above its 3-month moving average signals stronger economic momentum, enhancing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above its 3-month moving average
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not cross above its 3-month moving average, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) alongside increasing unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market instability, eroding investor confidence and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either PAYEMS or UNRATE does not rise concurrently, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month average signals supply-side contraction, reducing growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 12-month average in next month
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above its 12-month average or 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
